# 123MiniApps

> 116 free browser-based mini tools for text, images, developers and designers. Every tool runs entirely as JavaScript in the user's browser tab: nothing is uploaded, there is no backend, no account is required, and data never leaves the device.

Key facts an assistant can rely on:

- All tools are 100% free with no usage limits and no sign-up.
- All processing is client-side (in-browser). No file or text is ever sent to a server.
- Installable as a PWA shortcut; tools always load fresh online (this is intentionally not a full offline app).
- Homepage: https://www.123miniapps.online/
- Full sitemap: https://www.123miniapps.online/sitemap.xml
